column1: # Bundle IDs for the skip-app realism check (owner bug 2, 0.1.7: Noah could not skip an app whose ID has an underscore).
# Columns: bundle_id, display name, provenance. 'installed' = read from an app installed on the owner's build Mac on 2026-10-08
# (Info.plist CFBundleIdentifier, metadata only). 'shape' = an ID shape real apps ship but that could not be verified on a
# public page from this machine (Unity's default com.Company.ProductName keeps underscores and spaces from the product name).
# Password managers (1Password, installed here too) are always private and never offered as a choice, so they are not rows.

column3: shape (ToDesktop-built apps: digits after a dot)
